paragraphs: Huna bar Geniva — [Kohelet Rabbah, end of chapter 4](https://www.sefaria.org/Kohelet_Rabbah.4.17.1).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Abuha bar Geniva in a question to Rava. The linked Midrash gives Huna bar Geniva in the teaching about reciting Shema on time. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=999&lang=en) cites the latter under its opening verse, “Guard your step.” These are distinct occurrences.
